item.title: Fastmail 的歐洲區機房啟用
item.summary: 前幾天看到 Fastmail 宣佈啟用歐洲機房的消息：「Fastmail offers EU data region (via)」。 新機房在阿姆斯特丹 (荷蘭)： We’ve installed our own servers, co-located in a secure facility in Amsterdam, set up by our own engineers. 不過因為目前歐洲沒有其他機房的關係，資料還是會丟到美國機房備份： Resilient replicas of your data will live in the US (for now). As we only have one location in Europe so far, the geographically separate copy … Continue reading "Fastmail 的歐洲區機房啟用"
